martha.name: Martha
martha.comment: Martha, looks like a perfect morning for cycling, especially between 10:00–12:00 when it's nice and calm with ideal temps around 21°C. You might even convince Britt to join you if you promise a cold drink afterwards. The wind picks up a bit later, so get out early and make the most of it.

britt.name: Britt
britt.comment: Britt, looks like today's the day to get the bike out - 10:00–12:00 is your window for great cycling conditions, with ideal temps around 21°C. Just watch out for a noticeable headwind around 18 km/h, so maybe pick a route with a bit of shelter. When you're done, grab a drink on the terrace and enjoy the rest of the afternoon, maybe Martha can join you later.
